records.title: 10-K
records.text: In 2020, we generated $586.4 million in total revenue, with a revenue mix of: cloud subscriptions 14%; software license 6%; maintenance 25%; services revenue 52%; and hardware 3%.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: By comparison, in 2016, cloud subscriptions and software license revenue represented 7% and 93%, respectively, of our total cloud and software license revenue mix.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our international revenue was approximately $178.1 million, $189.1 million and $174.1 million for the years ended December 31, 2020, 2019 and 2018, respectively, which represents approximately 30%, 31% and 31% of our total revenue for the years ended December 31, 2020, 2019 and 2018, respectively.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: In 2020, license revenue totaled $38.3 million, or 6% of total revenue, with gross margins of 92.4%.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: For 2020, we generated cash flow from operating activities of $140.9 million and have generated a cumulative total of $425.1 million for the three years ended December 31, 2020.
